title: Stochastic Coordination Layer
brief: Build probabilistic models for ALL system coordination behavior — hooks, caches, timeouts, retries, circuit breakers. Replace fixed/deterministic thresholds with per-hook P(success)/P(FP)/P(FN) tracking, Bayesian dedup window optimization, Beta-Binomial adaptive circuit breakers, jittered retries with P(success|attempt) tracking, log-normal timeout calibration, cache staleness risk P(stale|TTL,write_freq), cascade failure conditional probability DAG, adaptive Monte Carlo convergence, silentCatch fire rate monitoring, dedup false positive tracking, hook latency budget, agent completion P(success|model,complexity), token cost variance (mean,sigma,95%CI).

phases.title: Stochastic Coordination Infrastructure
phases.description: Build probabilistic tracking, adaptive thresholds, and unified dashboard for all coordination subsystems — hooks, caches, dedup, retries, circuit breakers, timeouts, cascades, Monte Carlo, silentCatch, agents, and token costs.

units.title: Hook success rate tracker
units.rationale: Per-hook rolling 30-session statistics are the foundation for all downstream stochastic coordination — every other unit depends on having reliable P(success), P(FP), P(FN), mean latency, and P95 latency per hook.

steps.instruction: Create HookSuccessTracker class in ~/.claude/hooks/lib/ that records per-hook: fires, successes, false positives, false negatives, latency samples.
Add persistence layer writing/reading ~/.prism/coordination-stats.json with atomic writes.
Implement rolling 30-session window with auto-prune of oldest session data.
Wire into posttooluse-unified to capture hook execution results and latency.
Add P(success), P(FP), P(FN), mean latency, P95 latency computed properties.
Test with simulated hook data across 30+ sessions.

units.description: Hook success rate tracker — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Dedup window optimizer
units.rationale: Current dedup windows are fixed (60s/120s). Collecting empirical legit-vs-duplicate data per tool and fitting Beta distributions allows principled optimization minimizing P(false_dedup)+P(missed_dedup).
exit_conditions: Per-tool dedup windows optimized from empirical data
Window times differ per tool type

steps.instruction: Instrument pretooluse-unified to log every dedup decision: tool, interval_ms, was_duplicate (true/false), was_legit_repeat.
Build Beta distribution fitter from empirical (duplicate_count, legit_count) per tool.
Implement optimization: find window_ms minimizing P(false_dedup) + P(missed_dedup) using Beta posterior.
Store optimized windows in coordination-stats.json; fall back to defaults until 50+ samples.
Test with synthetic data showing convergence to optimal windows.

units.description: Dedup window optimizer — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Circuit breaker Bayesian model
units.rationale: Fixed 5-fail thresholds are either too aggressive (blocking transient failures) or too lenient (allowing persistent failures). Beta-Binomial P(permanent|N consecutive fails) adapts to actual failure patterns.
exit_conditions: Circuit breaker uses Beta-Binomial model instead of fixed threshold
Open duration adapts to failure pattern
Falls back to fixed threshold if insufficient data

steps.instruction: Implement Beta-Binomial model: prior Beta(1,1), update with (fail, success) observations per target.
Compute P(permanent failure) = P(theta > 0.8 | data) from Beta posterior CDF.
Replace fixed 5-fail threshold: open circuit when P(permanent) > 0.9.
Adaptive open duration: start short (5s), extend by 2x each re-open, reset on success.
Test with transient (recovers after 3) and permanent (never recovers) failure sequences.

units.description: Circuit breaker Bayesian model — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Retry strategy with jitter
units.rationale: Fixed exponential backoff without jitter causes thundering herd on shared resources. Adding +/-30% uniform jitter plus P(success|attempt N) tracking enables informed retry-vs-abort decisions.
exit_conditions: Auto-switches to linear backoff when P(success)<0.1

steps.instruction: Implement jittered exponential backoff: delay = base * 2^attempt * (1 + uniform(-0.3, 0.3)).
Track P(success|attempt N) per error type using rolling counters.
Add auto-switch: if P(success|attempt N) < 0.1 for all N > 3, switch to linear backoff.
Add abort condition: if P(success|attempt N) < 0.01, stop retrying.
Test with simulated transient and permanent error sequences.

units.description: Retry strategy with jitter — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Timeout calibration
units.rationale: Fixed timeouts are either too short (causing spurious failures) or too long (wasting time on stuck operations). Fitting log-normal to observed latencies per (action, effort) and setting timeout=P99+2sigma gives principled, adaptive timeouts.
entry_conditions: P0-U01 hook stats tracker collecting latency data
exit_conditions: Timeouts calibrated per (action, effort) from log-normal fit
Adaptive timeouts replace fixed values after 20+ samples
Fallback to fixed timeout with insufficient data

steps.instruction: Collect latency samples per (action_type, effort_level) tuple in coordination-stats.json.
Implement log-normal MLE fit: mu = mean(ln(x)), sigma = std(ln(x)).
Compute adaptive timeout = exp(mu + 2.326*sigma) + 2*exp(sigma^2-1)*exp(2*mu+sigma^2) (P99 + 2*stddev).
Apply adaptive timeout when sample count >= 20; use fixed default otherwise.
Test with synthetic latency data showing convergence to tight timeouts.

units.description: Timeout calibration — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Cache hit rate monitor
units.rationale: Caches with fixed TTLs risk serving stale data or evicting prematurely. Tracking per-key hit/miss/eviction and computing P(stale|TTL,write_freq) enables automatic TTL shortening when staleness risk exceeds 5%.
exit_conditions: P(stale) computed from TTL and write frequency

steps.instruction: Instrument all cache operations (ActionSchemaCache, ResponseCache, FrequentPath) with hit/miss/eviction counters.
Track write frequency per key: exponential moving average of inter-write intervals.
Compute P(stale) = 1 - exp(-TTL / mean_write_interval) for Poisson write model.
Auto-shorten TTL: if P(stale) > 0.05, set TTL = -ln(0.95) * mean_write_interval.
Persist cache stats to coordination-stats.json; test with varying write frequencies.

deliverables.description: Cache staleness risk monitor with auto-TTL adjustment

units.description: Cache hit rate monitor — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Cascade failure detector
units.rationale: PostProcessorPipeline has 26 stages x 20 dialects where upstream failures can cascade. Building a conditional probability DAG P(stage N fail | stage N-1 fail) and alerting on correlation > 0.7 enables proactive cascade detection.
features: P(stage N fail | stage N-1 fail)
exit_conditions: Dependency DAG built for 26 stages x 20 dialects

steps.instruction: Build stage dependency DAG from PostProcessorPipeline's 7 phases and 26 stages.
Instrument pipeline to record per-run: which stages succeeded/failed, per dialect.
Compute pairwise P(stage_j fail | stage_i fail) from co-failure counts.
Flag cascade risk when any conditional probability exceeds 0.7.
Test with simulated cascade (early stage failure propagating) and independent failures.

deliverables.description: Pipeline cascade failure conditional probability DAG

units.description: Cascade failure detector — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Monte Carlo convergence monitor
units.rationale: Fixed 500-trial Monte Carlo wastes compute when results converge early and under-samples when variance is high. Checking CI width after 250 trials and adaptively adding 250 more (capped at 2000) optimizes compute/accuracy tradeoff.
exit_conditions: Monte Carlo runs use adaptive trial counts

steps.instruction: Identify all Monte Carlo call sites: SpeedFeedOrchestrator (500), PostProcessor (500), SetupTransition.
Implement adaptive sampler: run 250, check CV = sigma/mu; if CV > 0.05 add 250 more; repeat until CV < 0.05 or N = 2000.
Track convergence stats: trials_used, final_CV, CI_width per invocation.
Replace fixed-count MC calls with adaptive sampler.
Test with low-variance (converges at 250) and high-variance (needs 2000) distributions.

units.description: Monte Carlo convergence monitor — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: silentCatch fire rate monitor
units.rationale: The 49 silentCatch sites suppress errors silently. Monitoring fires/session and fires/hour per site, plus P(cascade|catch), detects when suppressed errors are actually symptoms of systemic issues.
exit_conditions: All silentCatch sites emit fire events

steps.instruction: Modify silentCatch utility to emit a telemetry event on every catch: site_id, error_type, timestamp.
Aggregate per-site: fires_this_session, fires_per_hour (exponential moving average).
Track P(cascade|catch): probability that a catch at site A is followed by catch at site B within 1s.
Alert mechanism: log warning when any site exceeds 5 fires/session.
Test with simulated rapid-fire errors and cascade sequences.

deliverables.description: silentCatch fire rate and cascade detector

units.description: silentCatch fire rate monitor — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Dedup false positive tracker
units.rationale: When dedup blocks a call, there is no feedback on whether blocking was correct. Recording blocked calls and post-session analysis reveals the false positive rate, feeding back into P0-U02 window optimization.
exit_conditions: Every dedup block is recorded with context
FP rate tracked per tool and fed to optimizer

steps.instruction: On every dedup block in pretooluse-unified, record: tool, args_hash, timestamp, session_context.
Post-session: analyze blocked calls — if same tool+different args was called later, prior block was likely FP.
Compute FP rate per tool; persist to coordination-stats.json.
Feed FP rate into P0-U02 Beta distribution as additional evidence.
Test with known FP and true-positive dedup sequences.

deliverables.description: Dedup false positive detection and feedback

units.description: Dedup false positive tracker — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Hook latency budget
units.rationale: Hooks must not add perceptible latency. A 500ms budget per tool call with P(exceed) tracking and auto-skip of low-priority hooks under pressure keeps the system responsive.
exit_conditions: Low-priority hooks auto-skipped when approaching budget

steps.instruction: Assign priority levels (1-5) to all hook check blocks based on impact.
Implement budget tracker: accumulate hook latency per tool call; track P(exceed 500ms).
When elapsed > 350ms, skip remaining hooks with priority < 3.
When elapsed > 450ms, skip all remaining hooks except priority 5 (safety).
Log skip decisions; track P(skip) per hook for priority re-ranking.

deliverables.description: Hook latency budget enforcer with priority-based skip

units.description: Hook latency budget — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Agent completion rate by model
units.rationale: Agent spawns vary widely in success rate by model and task complexity. Tracking P(success|model, complexity, maxTurns) enables data-driven model selection for new spawns.
exit_conditions: Agent completion rate tracked per (model, complexity, maxTurns)

steps.instruction: Instrument Agent tool wrapper to record: model, task_description, complexity_score, maxTurns, actual_turns, success/failure.
Estimate complexity from: task word count, expected tool calls, domain (code/search/analysis).
Compute P(success|model, complexity_bucket, maxTurns) from historical data.
Recommend model: pick cheapest model where P(success) > 0.9 for given complexity.
Persist agent performance data to coordination-stats.json; test with simulated spawns.

units.description: Agent completion rate by model — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Token cost variance tracker
units.rationale: Token costs vary significantly session-to-session and skill-to-skill. Tracking mean/sigma/95%CI per session and per skill enables anomaly detection for runaway costs (>2sigma from mean).
exit_conditions: Token cost tracked per session with mean/sigma/95%CI

steps.instruction: Integrate with SessionTokenLedger to capture per-tool-call token costs.
Compute running mean/sigma per session; compute 95% CI = mean +/- 1.96*sigma/sqrt(n).
Track per-skill aggregates: mean cost, sigma, min, max over rolling 30 sessions.
Flag anomalous sessions where total cost > mean + 2*sigma of historical sessions.
Persist cost variance data to coordination-stats.json; test with synthetic cost sequences.

deliverables.description: Token cost variance tracker with anomaly detection

units.title: Stochastic coordination dashboard
units.rationale: All 13 prior units produce probabilistic metrics. A unified dashboard aggregating all P() metrics, rolling windows, trends, and anomaly flags into ~/.prism/coordination-stats.json provides complete coordination observability.
exit_conditions: Dashboard displays all P() metrics from all 13 subsystems

steps.instruction: Design unified coordination-stats.json schema: sections for hooks, dedup, circuits, retries, timeouts, cache, cascades, mc, catches, agents, tokens.
Build dashboard renderer: table format showing each subsystem's key P() metrics, trend arrows, anomaly flags.
Add trend analysis: compare current 5-session window to prior 25-session window; flag significant shifts.
Create /coordination-stats skill that renders dashboard on demand.
Add SessionStart auto-summary: one-line health status if any anomalies detected.
Integration test: populate all subsystem data, verify dashboard renders correctly.

deliverables.description: Skill to render coordination statistics dashboard
